name: purge-term
about: Your text (source.md) with every match of `term` removed or replaced — an old product name, a retired term, a person's name — and nothing else lost: numbers, URLs and placeholders kept, the length close to the original. For a rename, `replacement` must then appear at least `replacements` times. Proves the term is gone and those items survived, not that the prose reads well.
instructions: Reply with the whole revised text only. Change only what the task names; keep every other sentence, number, URL and placeholder such as {name} exactly as written.

term.about: a regular expression (Rust syntax) for what must be gone, e.g. (?i)\bquill\b — case, word boundaries and plurals are yours to say

replacement.about: for a rename: a regular expression for the new wording, e.g. (?i)\binkwell\b; leave empty for a plain purge

replacements.about: the fewest times `replacement` must appear in the result (for a rename: how often the old term appeared, plus the new one's own uses)

keep.about: what must survive: any of numbers, urls, code, placeholders, headings (leave out urls or code when the term is inside them)

min_ratio.about: shortest allowed, in words, against the original

max_ratio.about: longest allowed, in words, against the original
